questions.text: How many eyes does a bee have?
questions.fact: Two large eyes and three small ones on top of the head.

questions.text: How many hours a day does a koala sleep?
questions.fact: Its eucalyptus diet gives little energy, so it saves it.

questions.text: How many times per second does a hummingbird beat its wings?
questions.fact: In display flights, it can go over 200 beats per second.

questions.text: How much does an elephant eat per day? (kg)
questions.fact: It spends up to 16 hours a day eating.

questions.text: How many languages are spoken in the world today?
questions.fact: Almost half of them are at risk of disappearing.

questions.text: How many rooms does Buckingham Palace have?
How tall is the Leaning Tower of Pisa? (m)
questions.fact: It started to lean while it was still being built, in the 12th century.

questions.text: How long is the Great Wall of China, counting all its sections? (km)
questions.fact: Contrary to popular belief, it is not visible from space with the naked eye.

questions.text: In what year was the first email sent?
questions.fact: Ray Tomlinson picked the @ to separate the user from the computer.

questions.text: How many emojis are there in the Unicode standard?
questions.fact: The first set of emojis was created in Japan, in 1999.

questions.text: How many seeds does a strawberry have, on average?
questions.fact: The little dots on the outside are actually the strawberry's true fruits.

questions.text: How many liters of sap does it take to make 1 liter of maple syrup?
questions.fact: The sap is boiled down until only the syrup is left.

questions.text: How long does it take hair to grow 1 cm? (days)
questions.fact: Each hair grows for 2 to 7 years before it falls out.
